title: Minecraft block state definition
description: Defines the mapping between block states and models.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: Maps block state combinations to models.

multipart.title: Multipart
multipart.description: An alternative to variants, combines models based on block state properties.

when.description: Lists the conditions that must be met for the model to be used. When not set, the model is always used.

oneOf.description: Array of conditions treated as OR: the model is applied when any condition matches.

apply.description: Specifies the model to use and its properties. Can be a single model or a list of models. When a list is used, the game randomly selects one model from the list.

model.title: Model
model.description: Specifies the path to the model file, as a namespace ID.

x.title: X rotation
x.description: Rotation of the model around the X axis, in increments of 90 degrees.

y.title: Y rotation
y.description: Rotation of the model around the Y axis, in increments of 90 degrees.

z.title: Z rotation
z.description: Rotation of the model around the Z axis, in increments of 90 degrees.

uvlock.title: UV lock
uvlock.description: Can be true or false (default). When set to true, the texture's rotation is locked, so the texture will not rotate with the block when using the x, y, and z tags above.

weight.title: Weight
weight.description: Sets the probability of this model being selected. Defaults to 1 (100%). When multiple models are used for the same variant, each model's selection probability is its weight divided by the sum of all model weights.

Key is a comma-separated list of block state values (e.g. facing=east,half=lower). Different tags specify different models; the game randomly selects one model from the list.

OR.description: Matches if any of the conditions in this list return true. Cannot be combined with other individual conditions.

AND.description: Matches if all of the conditions in this list return true. Cannot be combined with other individual conditions.

oneOf.description: Block state value. Multiple values can be separated with |. A ! prefix indicates negation, e.g. !true|side.
